agent_explanation: Controller violates fmax at step 1: force 105.53 > limit 81.179. With kp=28.6 and vcmd=4.41 toward waypoint (16.5,3.6) from (14.2,11), desired velocity magnitude is 4.41, so kp*velocity_error ≈126 before noise, exceeding fmax. The controller does not clamp the commanded force to fmax (noise 0.219 added, still >limit). Counterfactual raising fmax to 200 eliminates violation with same dynamics, confirming missing/incorrect clamping.
